exp-125: no EMA + LR=3e-5 to isolate LR effect on clustering; exp-122 EMA+LR=3e-5 gave primary=62.60 with cluster +6.21 but PairClass -3.36; exp-124 EMA+LR=3e-5+FT=15min gave 62.67 but PairClass still -2.22 and FT was 99% saturated; hypothesis: LR=3e-5 alone drives the clustering improvement and without EMA PairClass will recover; FT reverted to 5min (99% sat at 15min proved wasteful); all other settings match exp-122 baseline (temp=0.03, CLS, 180min, B=64, symmetric, 12 datasets); baseline exp-117 LR=5e-5 primary=62.34

exp-126: contrastive LR=2e-5 (was 3e-5); exp-125 no-EMA+LR=3e-5 set new best primary=63.10 (+0.76 over LR=5e-5 baseline); LR trend: 5e-5→3e-5 was +0.76; lower LR gives more stable gradients at temp=0.03 and more training steps (8449 steps at 1.28s/step); hypothesis: LR=2e-5 further improves retrieval (48.44) and classification (69.85); EMA stays disabled (exp-125 proved LR is the driver, not EMA); FT=5min (still 99% saturated — consider reducing further); all other settings match exp-125 (temp=0.03, CLS, 180min, B=64, symmetric, 12 datasets)
